description: External and manual evidence required before Accounting Agent may receive any real-client byte.

evidence_policy.note: Evidence paths are reserved locations only. The current checker does not consume them or turn them into approval.

gates.title: DPA, DPIA, ROPA and subprocessor review
gates.owner_role: independent privacy counsel or appointed privacy lead
acceptance_criteria: Controller and processor roles are decided for each supported workflow.
DPA, DPIA, ROPA, subprocessor and transfer decisions are approved by accountable owners.
The accepted scope is bound to a dated product and architecture revision.

gates.title: Swedish accounting and archive scope review
gates.owner_role: independent Swedish accounting and archive counsel
acceptance_criteria: Supported record classes and excluded record classes are explicit.
Retention, original-format, presentation, location and migration controls are accepted.
No blanket Swedish or international compliance claim is introduced.

gates.title: Tenant and legal-entity isolation assurance
acceptance_criteria: Application authorization, PostgreSQL RLS, composite keys and object access are adversarially tested.
Cross-tenant and cross-entity access attempts fail at every storage and service boundary.
No caller-supplied tenant or entity scope is trusted without membership revalidation.

gates.title: Encryption and key-management assurance
acceptance_criteria: Encryption at rest and in transit is verified for every authoritative store and backup.
Tenant and environment context is enforced in key use where the design requires it.
Rotation, revocation, denial and recovery procedures are exercised.

gates.title: Archive retention and WORM assurance
gates.owner_role: archive control owner and independent reviewer
acceptance_criteria: Retention calculations are independently checked against the accepted record scope.
Early deletion and retention shortening are technically impossible for accepted records.
Legal holds, original preservation, presentation and export are verified.

gates.title: Append-only audit and external anchoring assurance
acceptance_criteria: Access, model, policy, review, connector, archive and administrative events share one immutable schema.
Tampering, truncation and cross-tenant substitution are detected.
Daily roots are signed and retained in an independently controlled immutable account.

gates.title: Backup, tenant restore and disaster-recovery exercise
gates.owner_role: service owner and independent exercise observer
acceptance_criteria: Encrypted point-in-time and immutable cross-account backups are restored in an isolated environment.
A tenant-level restore reproduces independently verified manifests and preserves isolation.
Measured RPO and RTO satisfy the approved service objectives.

gates.title: Manual accessibility acceptance
acceptance_criteria: VoiceOver, keyboard, zoom and authentication journeys pass on the exact release revision.
The authenticated locale, mode and role matrix has no unresolved A or AA blocker.
Evidence identifies tester, environment, revision and tested artifact digest.

gates.title: Incident tabletop and customer-notification path test
gates.owner_role: incident commander, privacy lead and service owner
acceptance_criteria: Detection, containment, evidence preservation, legal assessment and recovery paths are exercised.
Regulator, controller and affected-person notification decision paths are timed and documented.
Exercise findings have owners, deadlines and no unresolved release-blocking item.

gates.title: Independent penetration test
acceptance_criteria: The exact production architecture and supported workflows are assessed.
No unresolved critical or high finding remains.
Retest evidence is bound to the remediated release revision.
